flora: Dense Conifers (towering trunks, tiered branches arranged in organized whorls)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; forest canopy should look like layered, puffy green cushions stacked vertically; avoid fine, noisy, individual pine needle assets; trunks are thick, column-like, and deeply textured with soft, rounded bark ridges.

visual_logic.composition: A deep vista view peering into a dense, ancient conifer forest. Massive trunks create a sense of scale, with a thick, mossy forest floor leading into a dark, shadowy background.
visual_logic.ground: A rich carpet of dark ash gray soil covered in a dense layer of decomposing brown organic mulch and bright green log moss.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; strong shafts of dappled sunlight piercing the dense overhead canopy, creating brilliant high-contrast spot-highlights on the mossy ground.
